interface.shortDescription: Search InterPro entries, map protein domains and functional sites, and find proteins by domain via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Explore protein families, domains, and functional sites through InterPro. Search entries, inspect their biological annotations, and find proteins that carry a domain to connect sequence features with function. Use the server through STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
